title: Volume Discount Recapture on Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Cancellations
content:
**Volume discount recapture.** When a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans is cancelled, a recapture applies if the plan was sold below its retail plan price. The rate depends on how long the plan was in force, counted in whole months from the sale date to the effective date.

| Plan sold below the retail plan price, in force | Recapture rate |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 12 whole months | 1.0 (100 percent) |
| 12 or more, but fewer than 24, whole months | 0.5 (50 percent) |
| 24 or more whole months | No recapture |
| A plan sold at the retail plan price (any time in force) | No recapture |

The recapture deducted is that rate times the difference between the retail plan price and the purchase price, rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** A plan with a retail price of 1,100.00 was sold for 1,012.00, a difference of 88.00.
| Whole months in force | Recapture deducted |
|---|---|
| 7 | 88.00 |
| 12 | 44.00 |
| 23 | 44.00 |
| 24 | none |

With a difference of 87.55, a rate of 0.5 gives 43.775, which rounds half up to 43.78.
